Robux Tracker 6.2

EXTENSION (recommended: sidebar item + background sync)
 1. Open edge://extensions or chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode.
 2. Load unpacked -> choose the "extension" folder next to this file.
 3. Open roblox.com. "Robux Tracker" is in the left sidebar. Alt+R also opens it.
 4. Settings -> Advanced -> "Sync in the background every N hours" (only runs while a roblox.com tab is open).

USERSCRIPT (no background sync)
 Install Tampermonkey, make a new script, paste robux-tracker.user.js.

FIRST RUN
 - Press Sync. Then open roblox.com/transactions and click each type in the dropdown once
   (Creator Rewards, Robux Transfers, Roblox Adjustments...). Sync again.
 - Robux -> "Does it add up?" and Settings -> "Matches Roblox's own totals" show whether anything is missing.
 - Settings -> Advanced -> "Save diagnostics file" to send me what Roblox really returns.

Alts: sign into the alt on roblox.com and press Sync. Another browser? Backup there, Restore here.
Nothing leaves your browser. It never asks for a password.
